title: The first supervised autopilot run is executed stage by stage by an operator-agent, and every failure is filed
goal: After SP-j6hh2ib2 and SP-zihqagoi have closed, an interactive agent session acting as the operator (the operator's own order, recorded in the sprint notes) runs kb/_self/autopilot-test.md stage by stage against a throwaway sprint with the runner supervised, writes the per-stage pass/fail log to kb/_self/reports/, files each failure as a bug with a repro and each process finding as a retro finding (at most 5 per sprint, none for a retro), and ends with a go or no-go for an unattended run that names what only the human operator can still set (deploy key, branch protection, separate OS user). It answers no secrets, push or agents-rule gate beyond the throwaway sprint and never runs kbgit.py publish.
